plugins.name: guardrail-manager
plugins.description: Hooks that catch the mistakes sessions make around shared working trees and skipped review steps: warn when other Claude Code sessions are active in the same checkout, restate the branch before a git commit or push, remind about a repo-declared review policy the transcript shows was skipped, warn before spawning a new branch or worktree once the checkout already carries a budget's worth of parallel work (reconcile to main first), send a session that stops to ask "shall I merge?" back to merge and continue, and deny any git command that resolves a conflict with -X ours/theirs, -s ours or checkout --ours/--theirs

plugins.name: wiki-manager
plugins.description: Maintain a standing LLM knowledge base compiled from a NotePlan vault, shaped as an FAQ dependency graph and partitioned into domain SPACES (family, work, business, venture, plus a public floor) each bound to a confidentiality/PII tolerance. Each article answers one question and carries a space; derived answers build on other answers within their own space or the public floor only, so the crawl-down-to-base-facts never leaks one domain's confidential content into another. Ingests the Unorganized inbox into grounded, cross-linked articles under Notes/📚 Wiki/<space>/, keeps a hub + per-space indexes + a shared log, answers per space with citations, lints for fidelity, dependency cycles, and cross-space compartment leaks, and reorganizes the inbox without rewording content — with a git-backed content-preservation linter that proves no original source line is lost across a reorganization or split. No secret enters any space. Keeps pages lean for a first-time reader: a page body is Short answer → Evidence → Context → Gaps and nothing else, cross-links live in frontmatter (depends_on / leads_to) instead of body sections, and a running newcomer verdict per page records what to read, what to skip, and whether the page is lean or bloated — kept fresh by a content hash. Report-only SessionStart hook, plus advisory Stop hooks for a stale concept map or a stale verdict.

plugins.name: development-manager
plugins.description: Comment on your local web pages and have Claude answer. Adds a Comment button to pages served on localhost (in front of your dev server, or serving a folder), saves each comment thread as a file in the repo that git tracks, takes a picture of the commented element (kept out of git, in iCloud Drive by default), and runs a watcher so Claude hears new comments, fixes or answers them at the source, replies on the page, and closes a thread only once its fix is committed. You can also comment from your phone through your own Tailscale network (never Funnel), with a touch mode. Comments find their element again after the page changes, flag when it changed, and list the ones they cannot find; a post-commit hook notes which commit took in work a comment was made on. One enable step sets up the repo, proves the loop with a test comment, and undoes cleanly.
